title: Actual paid complete declared role-domain comparison
algorithm: Restore only exact complete role-domain records; independently verify the original source, comparison, preparation and role evidence once per setting. Never rerun accepted paid work. Bind new work to that exact native prefix and command history, paid observation view, original oldest demand and completed preparation.

Enumerate the entire declared Cartesian product in its already registered stable order. The evaluator supplies no successful role, route, recipe or nominee. For each request use the unchanged canonical selector or explicit workflow v4, including its existing capacity request validation. Retain native view rejection as rejection, not success. Never override a native nominee or old policy label.

A new separately versioned aggregate bind operation pays the sum of each valid request's existing native comparison extent: canonical 1+scanned+foreign_total+33+sum(examined), workflow 1+items+cells+sum(examined). Each native view validation rejection contributes one validation unit, an explicitly new engineering cost hypothesis, not a paid native candidate search. No discount, reuse credit or refund. The accepted original receipt does not cover this operation.

Commit compact per-assignment evidence containing exact request identity, validation status, snapshot hash, independently reconstructible candidate semantic projection, original nominee cell and exact extent. The projection contains the independent reference fields, not descriptive reason strings; no candidate or examined count is omitted. All inputs remain reconstructible from the unchanged paid native prefix and declared grammar. Full results become available only after complete native payment and settlement; partial, ready-uncommitted and cancelled states yield no result or receipt.

Use a protected new evidence namespace and new native checkpoint schema. Actual native operation lifecycle and wallets own payment. Block source writes/disclosure of protected evidence. Reject wrong pairing, unsettled preparation and preexisting suffix work. Commit must recheck owned view and cursor/profile inputs; no movement, content transformation, reserve change or history credit is authorized. Comparison does not resolve TD5 deferral or authorize support.

Independent auditor imports no new executor or selector: it separately enumerates the product, reconstructs native snapshots from paid particulars, uses the native independent reference algorithms, reconstructs validation rejection and all extents, and checks full native payment plus exact suffix versions and command prefixes. Saved before/partial/ready/complete/restarted/cancelled states roundtrip exactly; restart must match uninterrupted native bytes and results. Terminal steps are idempotent.

Gate requires eight exact new methods,436 exact predecessor method identities,12 exact saved records,all341 predecessor source identities unchanged and frozen new source. Any failure is preserved and corrected prospectively. This bounded sub-batch does not accept fresh task/skill panel, TD5 admission, live history choice, chosen movement/downstream use or matched full-route controls. Those remain the parent gate; all FT8 denominators and matched-main-cost obligations stay unchanged.
scope: Paid comparison only; execution_authorized=false, td5_admitted=false, history_choice=false. Fresh route-free task/skill work and genuine distinct-element tie-only chosen paid work remain mandatory. No bypass of older demand or TD5.
